build_learnable_memory_vit_adapter: build a learnable memory ViT adapter that freezes the ViT backbone and adds per-layer memory tokens for task-specific fine-tuning
create_vision_transformer_model: create a Vision Transformer model with configurable image size, patch size, depth, heads, and MLP dimensions for image classification
create_transformer_with_memory: create a Transformer with attention and feedforward layers that accepts per-layer memory tokens and optional attention masks
create_attention_with_memories: create a multi-head attention module that concatenates learnable memory tokens to key/value projections for memory-augmented attention
create_feedforward_network: create a feedforward network with LayerNorm, linear layers, GELU activation, and dropout for use as a Transformer block
